# Fixture provenance

These files are the canonical EasyEDA Standard examples linked from the
official format documentation:

- `easyeda-standard-schematic.json` mirrors the official
  [schematic example](https://gist.github.com/dillonHe/0b62babdb8ab3d2ad7d3).
- `easyeda-standard-pcb.json` mirrors the official
  [PCB example](https://gist.github.com/dillonHe/279c55659bb7065258b6).

Their original whitespace is intentionally retained to verify byte-identical
parse/serialize round trips.
